Title: Puzzling Genetics
Content: Gregor Mendel investigated the genetics of pea plants in the `text(1850s)`. He knew that the offspring of some plants always produce offspring of the same color. He crossed purebred white-flowering pea plants with purebred purple-flowering pea plants to produce generation `1`. Then, he crossed `text(two)` of the generation `1` offspring to produce generation `2`. The table shows the results of these crosses.
Mendel's work provided science with the basics of genetics.
